report.title: Health Risk Assessment Report
report.risk_indices_text: Evaluating 17 clinical risk indices based on your physiological biomarkers, vitals trends, and symptom duration. Scores indicate statistical percentile correlations relative to age-matched cohorts.
report.bio_age_text: Your Biological Age estimate is computed from a metabolic profile (blood sugar stability, renal filtration, thyroid panel, and cardiovascular elasticity metrics).
report.syndromes_text: Screening for metabolic and systemic syndromes (e.g. Metabolic Syndrome, Prediabetic Syndrome, Cardiovascular strain) based on criteria defined by regional health standards.

foods.heart: Oats, leafy greens, garlic, flaxseed, fatty fish, walnuts. Limit salt & processed foods.
foods.liver: Leafy greens, beetroot, turmeric, citrus fruits, green tea. Avoid alcohol.
foods.kidney: Reduce sodium & potassium-heavy foods (bananas, tomatoes), stay hydrated, limit processed meat.
foods.thyroid: Iodine-rich foods, selenium sources (Brazil nuts), avoid excess soy/raw cruciferous vegetables.
foods.metabolic: Low glycemic index foods, whole grains, finger millet (ragi), moringa (drumstick leaves), curry leaves, fiber-rich vegetables.
foods.blood: Iron-rich foods (spinach, lentils) + Vitamin C for absorption, folate sources.

exercises.heart: Brisk walking 30 min/day, swimming, cycling — avoid heavy strength training without clearance.
exercises.kidney: Light-to-moderate activity (walking, yoga) — avoid high-protein diet + intense exercise combo.
exercises.thyroid: Moderate aerobic + strength training, yoga for stress regulation.
exercises.metabolic: 150 min/week moderate cardio + 2x/week strength training to improve insulin sensitivity.
exercises.blood: General fitness routine is fine. No specific exercise restrictions.

supplements.kidney: Only under strict medical supervision. High dosage sensitivity.

gps.consent_desc: Smart Health Predictor requires your GPS location to search for nearby specialist doctors and hospitals matching your recommended specialties.
